Subject: Project Update: New Delivery Date of 14 April

Dear [Client Name],

I want to give you a clear update on the project timeline. The third-party integration required for this phase took longer to certify than the vendor originally indicated, and that certification step has pushed our schedule out by two weeks. The new delivery date is 14 April, and we are already working against that revised target.

Our team has adjusted the internal plan so that once certification is confirmed, the remaining implementation and testing work proceeds without further delay. We are also building in a small buffer around the certification handoff so that any last-minute vendor feedback does not put the new date at risk. Would 14 April still work well for your internal planning and any dependent milestones on your end?

We will keep you posted with progress updates as we move through the remaining stages, and we are happy to jump on a call if it would help to walk through the revised plan in more detail. Thank you for your continued patience and partnership as we bring this project to completion.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
